WoW Forever Druid Guides

Community builds for every Druid spec. Plan your own in the Druid talent calculator, follow the Druid class journey from level 1 to raids, or see the new Druid abilities and tier sets. Best PvP build per spec: Druid PvP.

Write a Druid guide

The Druid has three talent trees: Balance (DPS, 5 guides), Feral Combat (Tank or DPS, 7 guides) and Restoration (Healer, 4 guides). In guide terms, between them the trees cover DPS, Tank and Healer.

This page lists all 16 published Druid guides (3 PvE endgame, 3 PvP endgame, 4 solo leveling, 4 dungeon leveling and 2 group leveling); open a tree above for one spec. Plan your points in the Druid talent calculator, weigh the trees against each other with talent compare, or follow the Druid leveling guides. Every dungeon group needs a tank; the dungeon level chart shows which dungeons open at each level, up to the level 55–60 dungeons at the top of the chart.
